title: Keychron K2 V2 75% RGB Wireless Mechanical Keyboard

comparisons.notes: Keychron K2 75% RGB Version 2 with Super Brown switch, 4000mAh; in stock per store product data; matched by title and variant (third-party reseller).

writeup: Woot has the Keychron K2 Version 2, a 75% RGB wireless mechanical keyboard, new with a 1-year manufacturer warranty for $44.99 in Brown or Red switches. It pairs with up to 3 devices over Bluetooth and runs on a 4000mAh battery. Best Buy lists the same K2 at $89.99 and GearSpawn charges $109.99. Woot showed only 3 left, limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B07QCP491R (Brown switch) from Woot offer data, exact match per verified checker.
